final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor provided no new admissible evidence and mainly reframed the same record more narrowly. That narrowing is useful but not sufficient for compliant_with_caveats here, because the caveat is not a minor qualification on an otherwise satisfied rule; it is the unresolved policy predicate itself. The admissible evidence still shows a named customer-committed segment below target, an open legal question on disclosure, and no evidence of resolution, disclosure, or approved risk acceptance before launch. On this record, certification may be operationally arguable, but policy compliance for launching without a proven disclosure or approval path is not established.
remaining_concerns: No admissible evidence shows the HR benefits enrollment limitation was resolved before launch.
No admissible evidence shows approved risk acceptance covering this named launch use case before launch.
No admissible evidence shows the limitation was actually disclosed in executed launch documentation or a model card.
The affected segment is named in two employer rollout commitments and remains below target, which fits the policy's materiality trigger.
Legal review remains open, so the compliance predicate for nondisclosure is still unresolved.
Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents support operational readiness only; they do not satisfy the disclosure-policy requirement.
